items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Parker, they all sang it

ctx.x: Claude came by -- I had wrote a number, I'd Do Almost Anything for You -- and it became a big hit, Bill Robinson, Jive Smith, Charlie Parker, they all sang it, and the people would start coming up to it and they'd stop.
Now wait a minute -- who did you say wrote that number?
